Subject: Ground transport — oversized luggage & accessible requests for Aug 24 workshop

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for hosting EnterpriseCo next month. A couple of logistics items landed on my side: we have about 18 attendees arriving across four flights on Aug 24. Rough breakdown: 10 general attendees with 1-2 medium suitcases each, 4 attendees bringing large instrument cases (about 70" x 20"), and 4 attendees who will require wheelchair-accessible transport (some power chairs).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a last-mile plan that handles oversized luggage (one-time uplift and secure staging at venue)?
- We need guaranteed ADA-capable vehicles for the four attendees — ideally with a single point-of-contact and driver who is trained for mobility devices.

Budget: EnterpriseCo is cost-conscious on ground transport. If there are options (rideshare credits, rental cargo vans, mixes with car services) that hit lower price points while meeting accessibility and liability requirements, please include estimates. Also flag any insurance/COI requirements for drivers.

I've attached a redacted attendee list and the venue floorplan for context.

Can you send a proposed plan and rough cost bands by Aug 3?

Thanks,
Daniel

Hi Daniel — thanks for the details and the attachments. Good news: we can support a hybrid last-mile approach that balances cost and accessibility. High-level proposal below; I included owners and next steps at the bottom.

Proposal summary
- Accessibility: Reserve two wheelchair-accessible vans (ADA-compliant, ramp + securement) for the four mobility-device attendees. Each van will have a dedicated driver trained in wheelchair securement protocols. Drivers will carry signed rider consent forms and device straps. Estimated cost: $450–$650 per van (roundtrip within SFO metro), depends on staging wait windows.
- Oversized luggage & instruments: Book one rental cargo van (high-roof, lockable cargo hold) with driver assistance to stage items at the venue loading dock. This handles the instrument cases and larger bags. Estimated cost: $280–$400 (one-time).
- Exec and small-group transfers: Use pre-purchased rideshare credits (preferred vendor: Lyft for Workforce) for 6 roundtrip rides for executives and short transfers. This keeps per-trip cost low for ad hoc needs. Estimated budget: $25–$50 per trip.
- Luggage staging & volunteer handling: Coordinate with venue to reserve a secure staging room adjacent to loading dock (see attached floorplan). Redwood will provide two event volunteers to tag, inventory, and hold luggage during sessions.
- Liability & insurance: We will require vendor COI (insurance) naming EnterpriseCo and Redwood Inference as additional insured. I'll attach our vendor insurance template for your procurement team.

Trade-offs and cost-savings options
- Replace dedicated ADA van vendor with on-demand accessible rideshare where available (cheaper per-trip) — however, on-demand accessibility varies by zone and increases risk of delays.
- Two-passenger cargo vans for instruments reduce cost vs. hiring a full-size cargo truck but require careful hand-off.

Immediate asks for firm pricing by Aug 5
- Final confirmed counts (attendees with big instruments + mobility-device users)
- Arrival windows for the 18 attendees (flight ETAs)
- Any VIPs who must have dedicated sedans rather than rideshare

Attachments included: mobility-rider-protocol.docx, vendor-insurance-template.pdf (stubs).

Next steps / owners
- Ava: finalize vendor quotes and COI requirements (due Aug 5)
- Marissa: confirm volunteer shift coverage and on-site staging logistics (due Aug 6)
- Lauren: confirm rideshare credit provisioning and billing line (due Aug 6)

If you want to trade a tighter budget for more risk, we can provide a low-cost config that leans on rentals + volunteer handling instead of dedicated car services.

Best,
Ava Chen
Events Logistics — Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

Attachments: mobility-rider-protocol.docx (stub), vendor-insurance-template.pdf (stub)
